items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet minimum qualifications for the Information Technology Business/Technical Analyst I position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. Note: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. One year of education is equal to 30 semester (45 quarter) units. Education must be from an accredited institution. Options: I have a bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, management information systems, engineering or closely related field, and two (2) years’ experience directly related to the job duties. | I have a bachelor’s degree, and four (4) years’ experience directly related to the job duties. | I do not meet minimum qualifications for this position.
EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION: A bachelor's degree in computer sciences, management information systems, engineering or closely related field and two years' experience directly related to the job duties;
